description: This file contains serializers, codecs, and copiers for various F# core types (such as Option, List, Set, Map, Choice, Ref, and Result) in the Orleans serialization library. It enables serialization, deserialization, and cloning of F# immutable and reference types within Orleans.
published: FSharpChoice<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6>
FSharpChoiceCodec<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6>
FSharpChoiceCopier<T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6>

classes.description: Represents a reference to an F# type, encapsulating a value.
